gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Pen-line strokes that never swell or thin, that's Funnel Display, and it carries a commanding look. Noto Sans Limbu follows with tall-bodied small letters and curves that gape open, a plain sans that feels approachable beside it.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Noto Sans Lisu reads neutral and professional, with wide-open s curves and ascenders that barely clear the x-height line. Noto Sans Lisu sits quietly under Funnel Display, though a small heading would lose that single-width vinyl-cut punch.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-lydia: Approachable first, this body has capitals barely taller than lowercase and an opening like a sprung paper clip. Noto Sans Lydian gives Funnel Display's uniform, thick-thin-free strokes a friendly counterpart, and a modest body size lets it breathe.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-mahaj:
Funnel Display draws every line at a constant width, expressive and commanding.

Noto Sans Mahajani answers with lowercase standing tall against its capitals and a funnel-wide throat in the e, a modern plain sans beneath that heading.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-malay: Single-weight outlines with tips that never drift toward closing define Funnel Display, which is expressive and commanding. Noto Sans Malayalam handles the other job, with a middle zone that dominates each line and an s with generous openings between its bends.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-manda: Noto Sans Mandaic reads neutral, its lowercase rising close to the capitals and its curvy letters feeling unclamped. Noto Sans Mandaic would carry a long passage with an easy, loose feel, while Funnel Display keeps its one stroke width above it.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-march: Funnel Display builds spaghetti-like letters whose terminals end at exactly the width they began, expressive and commanding. Noto Sans Marchen sits below, a plain sans with proud small letters.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-mayan: Noto Sans Mayan Numerals reads professional and contemporary, with tall-bodied small letters and a c that gapes at any size. Noto Sans Mayan Numerals is the pair's quiet strength, since Funnel Display has no hairline anywhere and the body's openness softens it.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-medef: Contemporary in feel, the body here has lowercase that rises high and curves with no ink pooling where they turn in. Noto Sans Medefaidrin would read smoothly across a long passage, while Funnel Display keeps zero stroke contrast up top.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-sans-meete: Funnel Display draws unshaded, constant strokes with a commanding, expressive presence at the top of the page. Noto Sans Meetei Mayek handles the reading, with large lowercase eyes and rounds that gap like a cracked bangle.
